7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1. The quality assurance program for imaging services is documented.

7.2 The program addresses verification and/or validation of imaging methods.

7.3 The program addresses surveillance of imaging results.

7.4 The program includes periodic calibration and maintenance of all equipment.

7.5 The program includes the documentation of corrective and preventive actions.
